verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is documented as a self-hosted gateway that you run as one process on your own machine. It offers many install paths: desktop apps, installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, from source, and optional Docker. It also documents remote access via SSH or Tailnet and multi-tenant hosting with hardened container cells. The public GitHub repo and the 'Open-Source' positioning back this up, and a community user reports running 9 agents from one machine. Missing for 10: documented license terms and independent, in-depth hands-on reports of self-hosted installs.
